newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi 3-month T-Bill rate down shade at 14.42 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi 3-month T-Bill rate down shade at 14.42 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month treasury bills fell slightly to 14.42 percent on Monday from 14.69 percent two weeks ago, the central Reserve Bank said on Monday.
Applications for 106.2 million kwacha of bills on offer at the latest fortnightly tender were fully subscribed at an average price of 96.5 percent.
The average rate for six-month bills dropped to 15.39 percent from 16.02 percent two weeks ago.
Applications for 86.5 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at an average price of 93.0 percent.
For nine-month bills, the average rate fell to 14.75 percent from 16.57 percent two weeks ago. The 169.2 million kwacha of bills offered was fully subscribed at an average price of 91.0 percent.
